title: Asset price bubbles under model uncertainty and short-sale constraints: A discrete-time analysis
abstract: arXiv:2512.21115v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this study, we investigate asset price bubbles in a discrete-time, discrete-state market under model uncertainty and short-sale constraints. Building on a no-arbitrage pricing criterion and a super-hedging duality in this setting, we introduce a notion of bubble based on a novel definition of the fundamental price, and analyze their types and characterization. We show that two distinct types of bubbles arise, depending on the maturity structure of the asset. For assets with bounded maturity and no dividend payments, the G-supermartingale property of prices provides a necessary and sufficient condition for the existence of bubbles. In contrast, when maturity is unbounded, the infi-supermartingale property yields a necessary condition, while the G-supermartingale property remains sufficient. translated_title: 模型不确定性与卖空约束下的资产价格泡沫：离散时间分析
translated_abstract: 在本研究中，我们在模型不确定性和卖空约束下的离散时间、离散状态市场中研究资产价格泡沫。基于该设定下的无套利定价准则和超对冲对偶性，我们引入了一种基于基本价格全新定义的泡沫概念，并分析了泡沫的类型和刻画方式。我们证明了根据资产到期结构的不同，会产生两种不同类型的泡沫。对于有界到期且无红利支付的资产，价格的G-上鞅性质为泡沫的存在提供了充要条件。相反，当到期时间无界时，infi-上鞅性质给出必要条件，而G-上鞅性质仍是充分条件。此外，在一个强化的无优势条件下不存在泡沫。作为应用，我们考察了几个标准连续（原文此处截断）……的价格泡沫。
tldr: 该论文在模型不确定性与卖空约束下的离散时间市场中提出了基于基本价格新定义的资产泡沫概念，并证明泡沫类型取决于资产到期结构：有界到期时G-上鞅性质是泡沫存在的充要条件，无界到期时G-上鞅性质为充分条件而infi-上鞅性质为必要条件，且在强化无优势条件下不产生泡沫。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a novel notion of asset price bubbles based on a new definition of fundamental price in discrete-time markets under model uncertainty and short-sale constraints, showing that bubble types depend on maturity structure: for bounded-maturity assets the G-supermartingale property is necessary and sufficient for bubbles, for unbounded maturity the G-supermartingale property is sufficient while the infi-supermartingale property is necessary, and no bubbles arise under a strengthened no-dominance condition.
